Findings: warning: the lead's Stage 0 extraction saved only each oracle's markdown body — the structured invariants and open_questions arrays were printed to the console and never written to the oracle files, so the rulings pass found 6 of 56 question ids in the repo. Fixed by appending both lists from the workflow journal to every *.oracle.md; the 73 ruling rows in appendix B were derived from the oracles' stated defaults and stand.; The rulings pass measured: 54 oracle defaults stand, 12 adjusted with ADR reasons, 7 needed the lead (now ruled); one ADR-internal gap (no automated path could produce a ruling) fixed in §2.3 by stating the signed-import admission path.
